image_description: A grey whale breaching the surface of the ocean, showing its head, rostrum, and upper back. The skin is dark grey with characteristic white mottling from barnacles and cyamids. The arched rostrum is visible, along with the eye and pectoral fin area. The background consists of calm blue water and a distant hazy shoreline.
